                            globalThis._ddm.trigger('ab_testing', {

                let keys = ["utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_term", "utm_content"];

                }
                let isModified = false;
                keys.forEach(function (key) {
                    let val = params.get(key);
                    if (val) {
                        data[key] = val;
                        isModified = true;
                    }
                });
                if (isModified) {
                    globalThis.sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
                }
                return data;
            }
